reason: Value/transfer lens. (1) The ceiling does not survive recomputation. Per FN->TP edge the lab gain is 1/(TP+FP+FN) = 1/135,729 = 7.37e-6 (exp39 lab). The only association-type class is b_break, oracle +0.0011 (l6_fn_anatomy_report.md sec.1). Swaps, u_diverted and v_taken are localisation misses (motion model prefers our link in 98.6% of swaps, sec.3); a knob re-tune cannot change localisation. The linefit part of the +0.005 is already MEASURED DEAD: a_linefit nodes sit 6.6 um from GT before linefit and linefit moves them only 1.33 um (13/226 > 3 um); a 2 um cap loses 75 crossings-in to save 15 crossings-out (research/wf_ideas_v2/r2_critic.notes.md L11, r1_hyp_detection.notes.md L21). The forward-backward tie-break by 3-frame second-difference cost is the same criterion as swapfix, which gave -0.00004 on confirmation (sec.3). (2) The noise-model premise is weak. On held-out folds the public head's GT distance goes 1.73 -> 1.60 um, but z bias falls +0.73 -> +0.35 um (out_full_P/report.txt). About 2/3 of the squared-error drop is a constant offset, and a constant offset cancels in frame-to-frame displacements. The random displacement noise that gates and smoothers see falls by only ~5-10% (derived estimate). B28's linefit curve (w0.5 -0.0053, w1.0 -0.0046 around w0.8 on 12 videos; RESULTS.md L108) gives a curvature of ~0.056 per unit^2. A ~10% noise shift moves the optimum by ~0.05 in weight, worth ~+0.00014. Gates of 6 vs 7 um sit 4-5 sigma out and are insensitive to a 10% noise change. (3) The premise that the head's value lives in the post-ILP chain is 1.2 sigma. +0.007 vs +0.002 is a difference of differences of four noisy LB scores (sd ~0.004 at noise ~0.003). Part of the +0.007 is the node multiplier: final nodes -2.9% ~ +0.0027 adj. The lab cannot reproduce that part (ILP with non-head edge probabilities). (4) Transfer is poor for this class. Relink off / bonus 2.5 / gshift all scored -0.002 on LB; relink-off was +0.0053 in the lab and -0.002 on LB; the edge filter was +0.016 in the lab and 0 on LB. The lab has an in-sample detector and edge net, so the ILP makes few association errors there. Its localisation noise is lower than on unseen embryos, and the head is in-sample on ~20 videos. The proposed re-tune direction (less smoothing, tighter gates, more own-velocity weight, 'because noise is lower') is exactly the direction in-sample optimism favours. On unseen private embryos with larger noise it can reverse. SELECTION is 64 6bba videos only, and 6bba has an embryo-specific z annotation offset. (5) A +0.0005 central gain cannot be detected against LB noise 0.003, so the probe cannot confirm it. The idea itself gives P(>= +0.002 LB) = 0.15; I put it at ~0.05. The cost is friend A (the scarce resource for detector and B35 work), ~8 CPU-h and a probe slot.
